description: This file implements the 'Surface' class for handling Wayland surface operations, including buffer attachment, commit, and scanout ID management, within the Wayland protocol implementation for Android.

classes.name: Surface
classes.description: Represents a Wayland surface, managing buffer attachment, commit, and surface state.

methods.name: Surface::SetRegion
methods.description: Sets the region of the surface.

methods.name: Surface::Attach
methods.description: Attaches a buffer to the surface.

methods.name: Surface::Commit
methods.description: Commits the current buffer, processes it, and notifies the surfaces of surface creation or frame updates.

methods.name: Surface::SetVirtioGpuScanoutId
methods.description: Sets the scanout ID for virtio GPU.
